concepts.quote: isDone = (i % 5 == 0); would do the same as the if.
concepts.why: Relates the if-sets-flag pattern to a direct boolean assignment; the equivalence holds here only because the loop exits as soon as isDone is true, and the student gives no such reasoning, so it is an adaptation to a familiar variant (relational), not justified L4 reasoning about the change.
Shows that the right-hand side can be any expression of compatible type (a boolean expression stored in a boolean variable), but no trace or value reasoning is given.
Reuses i % 5 == 0 as a boolean-valued divisibility test without computing or explaining any remainder value.
